add_failures_to_list: run the script with --add to append new test failures from a file to the failure list
remove_failures_from_list: run the script with --remove to delete test failures from the failure list file
update_failure_list_in_place: run the script to update a failure list file in place by adding and removing entries
check_add_remove_conflict: run the script and verify it raises an exception when the same test is in both add and remove files
review_failure_list_script: review the script to understand how it merges sorted test entries while preserving comments
